records.source: A key-shaped model with a sharp tip is printed at different bed temperatures to determine a bed temperature that minimizes warpage. Due to stress concentration, the sharp tip of the model detaches from the hot bed upon tiny tendency of shrinkage. From then on, most residual stress tend to release near the sharp tip, making it curl up. By comparing the extent of the curling of models printed at different bed temperatures, one can tell which bed temperature provides better adhesion.
records.target: 在不同热床温度下打印带有尖端的钥匙形模型，以确定能使翘曲最小的热床温度。由于应力集中，一旦出现微小的收缩趋势，模型的尖端就会从热床上脱离。此后，大部分残余应力往往会在尖端附近释放，使其向上卷曲。通过比较不同热床温度下打印模型的卷曲程度，即可判断哪个热床温度能提供更好的附着性。

records.source: Grid sparse infill is printed at different volumetric flow rates. Once the flow exceeds the hot end's melt limit, under-extrusion appears and the internal infill layers do not bond well, creating voids. After printing, hold the sample against a steady light source and check whether light passes through the internal crossing area. Light leakage means the extrusion was unstable at that speed. The last speed with no leakage is taken as the maximum reliable speed.
records.target: 网格稀疏填充以不同的体积流量打印。一旦流量超过热端的熔化极限，就会出现挤出不足，内部填充层无法良好粘合，从而产生空隙。打印后，将样品对着稳定光源，检查光线是否穿过内部交叉区域。漏光意味着在该速度下挤出不稳定。没有漏光的最后一个速度被视为最大可靠速度。

records.source: PLA (polylactic acid) is a semi-crystalline, low-glass-transition material ([[[p:0]]]). Unlike engineering plastics such as ABS or ASA, PLA needs rapid cooling after extrusion to solidify. Because PLA's [[[p:1]]] is usually between 50 °C and 60 °C, insufficient cooling can soften the filament inside the heatbreak and cause a clog. At the same time, PLA keeps excellent interlayer bonding even with heavy cooling, so most manufacturers (including Bambu Lab) set the minimum fan speed to 100% or close to it by default. Therefore, cooling calibration for PLA only needs to find the maximum fan-speed threshold.
records.target: PLA（聚乳酸）是一种半结晶、低玻璃化转变温度的材料（[[[p:0]]]）。与 ABS 或 ASA 等工程塑料不同，PLA 挤出后需要快速冷却才能固化。由于 PLA 的 [[[p:1]]] 通常在 50 °C 至 60 °C 之间，冷却不足会使耗材在喉管内软化并导致堵塞。同时，即使大幅冷却，PLA 也能保持出色的层间粘合，因此大多数制造商（包括 Bambu Lab）默认将最低风扇速度设为 100% 或接近 100%。因此，PLA 的冷却校准只需找到最大风扇速度阈值。
